Sasha: Quick heads-up — ran AWQ+INT8 vs FP8 vs GPTQ on zeno-v2 for function_call workflows. Noticed structured outputs (JSON/tool args) degrade for some quantized variants.

Omar: Can you paste a minimal example?

Sasha: Sure — prompt + outputs below.

```
Prompt: call_tool('create_ticket', {"title": "Login bug", "priority": "high", "assignee": "alex"})

Float16 (baseline):
{"tool": "create_ticket", "args": {"title": "Login bug", "priority": "high", "assignee": "alex"}}

AWQ-INT8 (bad):
{tool: create_ticket, args: {title: Login bug, priority: high, assignee: alex}}

FP8 (bad - stray comma):
{"tool":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"Login bug", "priority":"high",}}

GPTQ (good):
{"tool":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"Login bug","priority":"high","assignee":"alex"}}
```

Sasha: On a 1k prompt eval: JSON parse failures — AWQ-INT8 9.2% | FP8 5.8% | GPTQ 0.3% | float16 0.1%.

evals-bot: Evals run #347 completed: 1k prompts, schema_validation column attached — https://redwood-evals/runs/347

Rachel: Interesting. Are failures concentrated at certain temperatures or prompt lengths?

Sasha: Mostly temp >=0.7 and prompts with nested dicts/arrays. Lowering temp to 0.2 halves AWQ failures. Also more failures when function_call is invoked directly vs. wrapped text.

Omar: Could be tokenization/byte-pair differences and rounding shifts producing unquoted tokens. Any pattern in first token emitted ("{" vs "{t" etc)?

Sasha: Yep — often the quote char (") token gets split or replaced by whitespace token in AWQ. Suggests quantization-induced logits shift around punctuation.

Mike: For safety let's block AWQ-int8 for `function_call` routes in hosted for now. Can we add runtime schema validation before calling tools?

Sasha: I'll open a PR for a lightweight JSON/schema checker + fallback that rejects and triggers a safer model (float16/GPTQ) path. Assigning to @Omar to re-run quant sweeps with per-channel vs per-tensor configs.

Omar: Ack. I'll start a sweep: adjust per-channel, try different outlier clipping, rerun at temps [0.2,0.5,0.8], and capture first-token distributions.

deploy-bot: NOTE: AWQ-int8 policy updated: temporarily disabled for `function_call` route in hosted tier (rollout id r-2026-03-18-01).

Rachel: Also recommend adding a small set of unit prompts to our regression eval that exercise JSON quoting/escape edgecases.

Sasha: Agreed. I'll add 200 prompts to the regression suite and wire the eval to fail builds if parse fail >1%.

Mike: Thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
